# `rand`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
rand([seed])
```

Returns a random value with independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) uniformly distributed values in [0, 1).

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1] |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT rand();
```

Result:

```text
0.9629742951434543
```

```sql
SELECT rand(0);
```

Result:

```text
0.7604953758285915
```

```sql
SELECT rand(null);
```

Result:

```text
0.7604953758285915
```
